say:0:1910714001:1.text: Are these things actually moving? Or is all of this an illusion?
say:0:1910714001:1.source_cn: 是这些东西会动……？抑或一切都是幻觉？
say:0:1910714001:1.male: Are these things actually moving? Or is all of this an illusion?
say:0:1910714001:1.female: Are these things actually moving? Or is all of this an illusion?

say:1:1910714002:1.text: You don't know anything. Your once-strong thirst for knowledge seems to bend at last to a fear you cannot name. Subconsciously, you no longer want to get to the bottom of this.
say:1:1910714002:1.source_cn: 你什么都不知道，向来强烈的求知欲似乎也屈服于莫名的恐惧...

say:1:1910714002:1.female: You don't know anything. Your once-strong thirst for knowledge seems to bend at last to a fear you cannot name. Subconsciously, you no longer want to get to the bottom of this.

say:2:1910714003:1.text: You just want to find a way out.
say:2:1910714003:1.male: You just want to find a way out.
say:2:1910714003:1.female: You just want to find a way out.
